_comment: The standard lead. Every source - the form, Gmail, the webhook - is converted
into this shape before anything else happens. That is what keeps the scoring,
deduplication, CRM and routing logic written once instead of three times.
Adding a fourth source means writing one small workflow that produces this.
lead_id: uuid, generated when the lead arrives
source_detail: where exactly, e.g. website-contact, facebook_ads, typeform
email: string, lower-cased and trimmed. REQUIRED: without it a lead cannot be deduplicated or contacted, so it goes to quarantine
website: string, may be empty. Used by the Premium enrichment step
office_size_sqft: number or null - one of the strongest scoring signals
cleaning_frequency: string, e.g. nightly, 3x per week, weekly, one-off
city: string, may be empty. Scoring cares whether it is in the Portland metro
message: string, what they actually wrote. The AI reads this
raw: object, the original payload exactly as it arrived - kept so a quarantined lead can be replayed by hand
